title: Flatness and tensor reduction for the finite constant completion tower
statement: theorem finiteSystem_flat_and_reduction (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) [∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Cᵒᵖ), Module (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1)) (adicTerm J A (finiteSystemUnder J A I) n U)] (htower : ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Cᵒᵖ), IsScalarTower A (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1)) (adicTerm J A (finiteSystemUnder J A I) n U)) : (∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Cᵒᵖ), Module.Flat (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1)) (adicTerm J A (finiteSystemUnder J A I) n U)) ∧ (∀ (m n : ℕ) (U : Cᵒᵖ), ∃ e : TensorProduct A (adicTerm J A (finiteSystemUnder J A I) m U) (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1)) ≃ₗ[A] adicTerm J A (finiteSystemUnder J A I) (min m n) U, ∀ (b : adicTerm J A (finiteSystemUnder J A I) m U) (a : A), e (b ⊗ₜ[A] Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) = a • adicTransition J A (finiteSystemUnder J A I) m (min m n) (Nat.min_le_left m n) U b)

source.place: Tags 093M and 0912, sectionwise flatness and tensor reduction

proof.text: The scalar tower and the surjectivity of A → A/I^(n+1) force the given module structure to be the canonical one induced by the sheafification unit. Fix R = A/I^(m+1) and U, and let G(M) be the sections over U of the sheafified constant presheaf with value the R-module M, so G(R) is the m-th term at U. G is additive and left exact (constant presheaf and sheafification exact, sections left exact) and preserves surjections: a surjection of sets p : M → N has a set-theoretic section s, and the constant sheaf of types (which commutes with the forgetful functor) splits G(p). Hence G is exact and M ⊗_R G(R) → G(M) is an isomorphism for finitely presented M (compare on a presentation). Flatness: for an ideal a of the Noetherian ring R, a ⊗_R G(R) → G(R) is G(a) → G(R), injective. Reduction: G(R) ⊗_A A/I^(n+1) = G(R) ⊗_R A/I^(min(m,n)+1) ≅ G(A/I^(min(m,n)+1)), the (min m n)-th term, and on b ⊗ mk a this is a • (transition b), the transition being G of the quotient map.
